title: agent_router.partial ubus event (answer text while the model writes it)
description: Response-latency plan 2026-11-10 step 3D (llm/docs/llm_response_latency_plan_20261110.md). Published by the agent core (AGENT_ROUTER_PARTIAL, on by default) only for an answer the code will not replace after the model ends (knowledge answers), never for a write, a dry run (dry_run:true) or a read. Display only: nothing is kept for later viewers and nothing is executed from it. `text` is the whole answer so far (not a delta), so a lost event does no harm; `i` grows within one request. The final agent_router.result of the same producer session and seq replaces it; a result that is not ok clears it. router_display maps (input.session_id | boot | input.source, input.seq) to the rid it will use for llm_reply and forwards CDC1 event agent_partial (docs/json_command_protocol.md).

request_id.description: = the transcript's seq (the core's request id).

text.description: The answer so far, at most 1000 bytes cut on a UTF-8 boundary, citing phrases removed as in the final text.
